6207: Lie on your left side and prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
Lower the leg without dropping your hips.
Switch sides for the right-side version.
6208: Lie on your left side and prop up on your left forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise your top leg to hip height.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides if you like.
6209: Extend your left leg straight behind you.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
6210: Set up in a left side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in front of you.
Extend back out to the straight position.
Repeat for reps, then do the other side.
6211: Lie on your back with your hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Twist to bring one elbow to the opposite knee.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
6214: Lie on your back with your legs lifted.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Cross one leg over the other.
Open and cross the other leg on top.
6215: Kneel holding a dumbbell in each hand on the floor.
Go as far as you can keep your back flat.
6218: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells at chest level.
Press up, rotating your palms forward.
6219: Stand sideways to a cable with the handle at chest height.
Pull the handle across your body.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
6220: Hold the straps and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
6221: Stand holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head.
6222: Hold the straps with your arms extended.
Go straight into the next squat.
6231: Start in a knee push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push your hips back toward your heels.
6232: Hold the straps and lean back.
Curl your hands toward your forehead.
6234: Hold the rings and lean back.
Curl your hands toward your head.
Keep your body in a straight line.
6237: Hold one ring and lean back.
Curl your hand toward your head.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
6252: Hold the rings and lean back.
Pull the rings toward your face.
6259: Hold one ring and lean back.
Pull your elbow out and back.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

6263: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
6264: Lie chest down on an incline bench.
Hold dumbbells with palms facing in.
6265: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
6266: Grip the SZ bar and extend your arms.
Curl the bar toward your head.
6267: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
6268: Stand holding one end of an EZ bar.

6269: Hold the handle with straight arms.
6270: Lie on a bench and grip the bar.
Lift your feet off the floor.

Lift your feet off the floor and stretch your legs out in front of you.
Lower the bar to your lower chest under control.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your back flat on the bench and your core tight throughout.
6272: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lie back.
Press the dumbbells up and lift your feet off the floor, legs extended.
Lower the weights to the sides of your chest with control.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core braced so your lower back does not arch.

Tuck your toes and lift your hips up high.
Press your forearms into the floor.
Let your head hang between your arms.
6290: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Bend your elbows straight back to about 90 degrees.
Keep your body in one line, elbows close to your ribs.
Hold briefly, then press back up.
6291: Stand with feet wide, turn your front foot out and back foot slightly in.
Bend your front knee over the ankle.
Extend both arms parallel to the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
6292: Start on hands and knees on a mat.
Slide your knees wide, with feet turned out and inline with knees.
6293: Kneel and place your hands on the floor with fingers pointing back toward your feet.
Bring your elbows together under your belly.
Lean forward and rest your torso on your upper arms.
Extend your legs back and lift them.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower.
6294: Lie on your belly, propped on your forearms.
Bend one knee and reach back to hold that foot.
Gently press the foot toward your hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
6295: Sit with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat beside the straight leg.
Wrap your opposite arm around the bent knee.
Sit tall, then twist toward the bent knee.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
6296: Stand and bind one arm behind your back around your bent knee.
Grab your hand with the other arm.
Step in and stand tall on the grounded leg.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch.
6297: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands beside your head with fingers toward your feet.
Press into hands and feet and lift your hips.
Straighten your arms as you lift the crown of your head off the floor.
Press your chest toward the wall behind.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower slowly.
6298: Come into wheel pose with hands and feet pressing down.
Lift the other leg toward the ceiling.
Keep your hips high and level.
Hold briefly, lower, then switch legs.
6299: Squat with hands on the floor in front of you.
Place your knees high on your upper arms.
Lean forward and lift your feet off the floor.
Extend your legs wide to the sides.
Hold for a few breaths, then release.
